title: Backend System Review: Database Migration and Authentication
summary: The team reviewed the PostgreSQL migration script, identifying missing indexes that Neha will add by tomorrow. The group agreed to use JWT for authentication, with Vikram responsible for the middleware by this coming Wednesday. Aditya will complete the dashboard UI by next Monday, contingent on Neha providing API endpoints by this coming Friday. The test plan for user registration is pending with no firm deadline, and API documentation remains unassigned.
key_points: The team discussed the status of the PostgreSQL migration script and identified performance issues due to missing indexes.
The team debated authentication options, comparing JWT and OAuth 2.0, noting that JWT suits the stateless system while OAuth might be needed for future third-party integrations.
Dependencies were established between backend API endpoints and frontend UI development for the dashboard.
Resource constraints were mentioned regarding the QA test plan, and the lack of an owner for API documentation was highlighted.

action_items.task: Add missing indexes to PostgreSQL migration script and re-run migration
Create test plan for user registration
